We need retrosynthesis route with max 1 step (i.e., direct purchase? Actually 1 step means one reaction from precursors to target). Leaves must be commercially available and total price <=125. Need propose a reaction template and precursors that are buyable.

Target: COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O. This is methyl ester of a keto? Actually structure: methyl ester of a carbonyl attached to a cyclopropyl? Wait: COC( ... )=O is methyl ester of a carbonyl attached to a quaternary carbon bearing a cyclopropyl? Actually C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C) is a cyclopropyl with a phenyl? Let's parse: C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C) is a cyclopropane where one carbon is attached to a phenyl with trimethylsilyl? Actually [Si](C)(C)C is TMS group attached to phenyl? The SMILES: COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O. So central carbonyl carbon attached to OCH3 and to a quaternary carbon bearing a cyclopropyl (C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)) and a trans-alkene to phenyl. So maybe it's a product of a Wittig reaction: ester of a ketone? Could be formed by esterification of a carboxylic acid with methanol. So we could get the acid precursor: OC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O (i.e., same but OH instead of OCH3). That acid could be commercially available? Search.
